snippet.title: MINOS INITIATIVE 2112 - OFFICIAL STEAM PAGE REVEAL
snippet.description:
Minos Initiative - 2112 is a dark sci-fi survival CRPG set deep beneath the surface of a dying world — inside a vast, fractured underground network known only as MINOS.

What began as a joint excavation and research project funded by powerful surface organizations has become something else entirely.
Something no faction fully controls anymore.

STORE PAGE

     https://store.steampowered.com/app/4538330/MINOS_INITIATIVE__2112/
